title: How /plan turns a request into an implementation-ready spec
subtitle: Final spec and every decision recorded before any code is written.
banner: The implementation-ready spec can now be handed to /implement in a fresh context window.

cards.title: CREATE THE PLAN WORKSPACE
bullets: Start from a direct request or existing `/brainstorm` notes
Create a name for the plan
Preserve any existing notes as the plan’s starting context
cards.note: Gives the plan a stable home without making `/brainstorm` a prerequisite

cards.title: RECORD THE FACTS
bullets: Inspect the code and files relevant to the plan request
Record the repository facts the plan will rely on
Verify every referenced file and path before moving forward
cards.note: Ensures the plan reflects the repository’s current state, not assumptions

cards.title: SETTLE THE SCOPE AND CONSTRAINTS
bullets: Decide whether the request needs one plan or multiple phases
Record the requirements and constraints the plan must follow
Planning agent asks questions until you are both aligned
cards.note: Prevents scope and project constraints from being decided during implementation

cards.title: CHOOSE THE APPROACH
bullets: Planning agent presents 2–3 distinct options with trade-offs
You choose the approach the plan will follow
Skip this step only when the approach is already settled
cards.note: Ensures the design is chosen before implementation begins

cards.title: WRITE THE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
bullets: Turn the verified facts and decisions into a complete plan
Validate the plan’s structure and revise it until it passes
Use one plan or split larger work into clear phases
cards.note: Creates the specification the implementation agent will follow

cards.title: STRESS-TEST THE PLAN
bullets: The planning agent questions you about edge cases and unresolved choices
You answer every decision that could change implementation
Every answer is added to the plan immediately
cards.note: Prevents the implementation agent from filling gaps on its own

cards.title: CATCH DUPLICATION BEFORE CODING
bullets: The planning agent searches for existing code related to the plan request
Decide whether to reuse, extend, extract, defer, or keep the code separate
Update the plan before implementation begins
cards.note: Prevents duplicate logic and competing abstractions

cards.title: GET THE PLAN TO AN A GRADE
bullets: The engine grades the plan and identifies every gap
The planning agent updates the plan to address each finding
Re-grade until it earns an A with no unresolved gaps
cards.note: Proves the plan is complete enough for an implementation agent with no prior context
